address: Avista Hideaway Phuket Patong - MGallery, 39/9 Muen-Ngern Road, Pa Tong Beach, Pa Tong, Kathu, Phuket, 83150, Thailand
bio: Inspiration from the opulent Mughal palaces makes its presence felt in this alluring restaurant, where the chef presents modern Indian cooking that embraces the times. He respects the diversity and tradition of Indian cuisine, crafting dishes that showcase his skills and experience. The aromatic plates are packed with spices and enhanced by a smoky flavour, bringing complexity and creative combinations to the palate....
